title: Founder & Owner
summary:
My mission is to inspire individuals, businesses, and organizations, teaching them how to implement systemic change and sustainable (business) practices. How? I offer 1:1 mentorships for ambitious sustainable entrepreneurs. If you're ready to embark on your own journey toward a better world, don't hesitate to visit my personal website for more details and get in touch. Together, we can create a more sustainable and impactful future.

Founder and owner of Dopper, Mama Gaia, and Oceans, as well as a sustainability ambassador, speaker, and advisor. My journey began in 2009 when I sat on the beach and witnessed the overwhelming amount of plastic waste left behind after a sunny day, slowly being consumed by the sea. At that very moment, I felt a calling to take action. It was the birth of the idea for sustainable water bottles that could help people reduce their single-use plastic waste, and that's when the Dopper was born.

In October 2010, the iconic Dopper design that we all know today, hit the market. Fast forward to 2023, and over 10 million people have embraced the Dopper, making it the world's #1 sustainable water bottle, proudly Cradle2Cradle certified GOLD.

Dopper became the flagship of my sustainable mission, illustrating how to drive global, systemic change. However, my commitment to sustainability doesn't end there.

I also own two other successful sustainability-focused businesses. Oceans, a sustainable co-workspace in Haarlem, is on a mission to inspire organizations and businesses to work more flexibly, accelerate progress, and create meaningful change.

Mama Gaia, an award-winning, plant-based restaurant in Haarlem, is where I'm fostering systemic change through sustainable and delicious food choices.

Today, my primary focus is on sharing my experience and insight as a speaker and providing guidance as an advisor and mentor. You'll find me talking on stage at various events and giving 1:1 mentor sessions.
titleDescription:
Proud founder and owner of the Dopper.

Dopper, a social enterprise (certified B-Corp), established since October 2009, promotes tap water to reduce plastic waste from single use plastic (mineral water) bottles. 
With part of the proceeds as well as in kind, Dopper contributes to drinking water projects in Nepal and education in western countries on reducing plastic waste. 

To make it easy for people not to use anymore single used bottles, Dopper has ‘the perfect bottle for tap water’. A Dutch design, 'the Original' is made in Holland with a net cero carbon footprint and without any toxins like BPA and with a Cradle2Cradle GOLD certification (since 2023), it can claim to be the best sustainable water bottle in the world.
Next to the 'Original', the portfolio contains a Steel, an Insulated and a Glass variation. All also Cradle2Cradle certified.

To give easy access to tap water, Dopper created an indoor water tap.
Offices, canteens and other indoor places can provide (filtered) tap water at any time of the day.
The Dopper water tap is, like the bottle, awarded with the Red Dot Award and the IF-design-Award.

Join our wave of change! 
Just refill!

Niet door simpelweg meer kapitaal toe te voegen, maar door eerst de juiste structuur te ontwerpen. Mijn werk begint vaak waar financiering vastloopt:  wanneer banken afhaken;  wanneer meerdere kapitaalvormen gecombineerd moeten worden;  wanneer risico, cashflow en zekerheden opnieuw in balans moeten worden gebracht;  of wanneer projecten een internationale kapitaalstrategie vragen.  Vanuit Financiering+ en F+ Digital Assets richt ik mij op het structureren van hybride kapitaaloplossingen voor vastgoed, bedrijven, AI-infrastructuur en andere real assets. Structure First. Capital Follows.  Info 🇬🇧 Financing is no longer straightforward. Banks finance less comprehensively, and standard solutions increasingly fall short. As projects become more complex, the real question is often not where capital comes from, but how the right capital structure should be designed. I work with entrepreneurs, developers and investors to design capital structures that are genuinely executable — with a clear capital hierarchy, appropriate security packages and a realistic repayment logic. Not by adding more capital, but by designing the right capital structure first. My work typically begins where financing stalls:  when banks step back;  when multiple layers of capital need to be combined;  when risk, cash flow and security need to be rebalanced;  or when projects require a cross-border capital strategy.  Through Financiering+ and F+ Digital Assets, I focus on structuring hybrid capital solutions for real estate, businesses, AI infrastructure and other real assets. Structure First. Capital Follows.

F+ Digital Assets focuses on the application of digital capital structures and tokenisation within private markets, for businesses, real estate and other real assets.
 
As the specialist label of Financiering+, we assess and structure how digital assets can be integrated into a broader Capital Architecture — from instrument design and governance to issuance, distribution and lifecycle management.
 
We do not see tokenisation as an objective in itself. Financeability and the underlying capital structure come first. We apply digital infrastructure where it creates demonstrable value in capital access, distribution, transparency, or efficiency.
 
We operate through an open architecture, working with specialised legal, regulatory, technology and distribution partners.
